facts.anchor: That week, Zak texted me a few times, and I brought him and Dale lunch twice, but it sounded like Dale was out of sorts after his day at the care home. They came to work late and left early,
facts.fact: 那周 Zak 短信不断、她送过两次午饭，但 Dale 从 care home 回来后一直不对劲（晚到早走）。

facts.anchor: I was missing Zak and trying not to be bothered by it, so I concentrated instead on what Georgia had said—that there’s no right answer. I understood Zak’s situation and didn’t expect more fr
facts.fact: Meg 复盘 Georgia 那句「没有正确答案」：她懂 Zak 的处境、不索取他给不了的东西。

facts.anchor: I wished I could be more like Georgia and go with the flow. I’d learned to do that in some respects. As a mom, I had to make adjustments on the fly. Same when Dad had been in treatment. Best
facts.fact: 她的接线式思维：他不承诺，我也不承诺；不承诺是否干脆别开始。

facts.anchor: Ugh. Maybe that’s what was really bothering me. I was starting to really like Zak. Really, really.
facts.fact: 她羡慕 Georgia 那种随波逐流——她自己当妈、当病父家属时练出的「on the fly」能力。

facts.anchor: My phone dinged as I was helping a customer. I patiently waited until they’d decided on a cock ring and bagged it up for them.
facts.fact: 真正的病灶被点名：她 Really, really 开始喜欢 Zak 了。

facts.anchor: “Have a good day.” I waved them out, then saw the text was from Roddie, telling me he was next door.
facts.fact: 她给 Roddie 发消息问「Want to run over for scones?」，等了一分钟。

facts.anchor: I’m hungry, I texted him. Feel like running over for scones?
facts.fact: Roddie 的回信成了本章结尾：Zak asked me to stay with Dale. His exit is here.（他改了错字）

facts.anchor: It took a full minute before he answered.
facts.fact: Meg 对着空店念出「What?」——悬念挂在「exit」这个双关上。
